scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of infinite-family statements, finite exact rational diagnostics, direct finite-pair KKT witnesses; literature priority best-knowledge and not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real unweighted finite trees, equal vertex least-squares masses, a common strictly positive symmetric edge-difference cap, and unit edge total variation; no claim for graph cycles, nonuniform weights, or one-input variation diminishing.
title: A sharp tree-branching law for variation sensitivity of bounded-slope least squares
